description: Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon is a prequel about young Cereza before she became Bayonetta. The player controls Cereza with one side of the controller and Cheshire with the other, combining magic, demon strength, elemental forms and environmental puzzle solving throughout the hand-painted Avalon Forest.

description_short: A storybook-styled action-adventure prequel where young Cereza and demon Cheshire are controlled together to explore, solve puzzles and fight faeries.
description_ar: مغامرة تمهيدية تحكي قصة Cereza قبل أن تصبح Bayonetta. يتم التحكم بـCereza وCheshire في الوقت نفسه، بحيث تستخدم Cereza السحر والربط بينما يقاتل Cheshire ويكتسب أشكالًا عنصرية، مع تركيز كبير على الألغاز والاستكشاف داخل غابة Avalon ذات الأسلوب القصصي المرسوم.

gameplayPillars.title: Control Two Heroes
gameplayPillars.description: Move Cereza and Cheshire with opposite sides of the controller, coordinating their abilities simultaneously.

gameplayPillars.title: Solve Magical Puzzles
gameplayPillars.description: Use Witch Pulse, Cheshire’s claws, Hug Mode and elemental forms to manipulate the environment.

gameplayPillars.title: Fight Together
gameplayPillars.description: Cereza binds enemies with magic while Cheshire attacks, creating a cooperative two-character combat loop.

gameplayPillars.title: Explore Avalon Forest
gameplayPillars.description: Search hand-painted regions for secrets, upgrade materials, Vitality Petals and new routes.

worldSummary: Young Cereza enters the forbidden Avalon Forest in search of power that might save her mother. Her first summoned demon, Cheshire, inhabits her stuffed toy. Together they confront faeries, solve magical obstacles and learn to trust one another.

storyChapters.title: A Young Outcast
storyChapters.body: Cereza longs to become strong enough to help her imprisoned mother Rosa.

storyChapters.title: Into Avalon Forest
storyChapters.body: Following a mysterious dream and a white wolf, Cereza enters the forbidden forest.

storyChapters.title: Cheshire
storyChapters.body: A demon summoned by Cereza becomes trapped inside her stuffed toy and reluctantly joins the journey.

storyChapters.title: Faerie Secrets
storyChapters.body: The pair confronts Avalon’s faeries and uncovers truths that shape Cereza’s future.

faq.q: Does Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes through backward compatibility where Nintendo marks the Nintendo Switch release as supported. This file does not classify it as a native Nintendo Switch 2 Edition.

faq.q: What language is the supplier version of Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon?
faq.a: Supplier listing language supplied by the user: Simplified Chinese. Official/regional language details are preserved separately in supported_languages_raw and nintendo_notes so the supplier SKU is not generalized to every region.

faq.q: Is Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon multiplayer?
faq.a: The main game is single-player; no multiplayer mode is asserted in this file.

faq.q: Why are some Switch 2 performance resolution fields blank for Bayonetta Origins: Cereza and the Lost Demon?
faq.a: Because exact measured Switch 2 backward-compatibility rendering values were not verified. The template is intentionally left blank rather than filled with hardware maximums or guesses.

verdictSummary: A distinctive prequel that trades the numbered games’ relentless character action for puzzle solving, exploration and a striking storybook presentation. Its dual-character control is the defining mechanic and gives the game a clear identity of its own.
